capabilities: Render chat code blocks as bubble cards
Show images and media lines inside bubbles
Insert date dividers and system notices
Assign stable avatar colors per sender
extras: Bilingual English/Chinese README; manual install by copying main.js, manifest.json and styles.css into the plugin folder.
problem: Chat exports pasted into a note stay as plain text, so conversations are hard to read and scan.
summary: Renders pasted chat exports inside chat code blocks as bubble-style chat cards in reading view.
